onboarding.welcomeBody: Offline downloads, local transcription, and image compression — every feature is free and open, no activation needed.
onboarding.downloadBody: Open Media Download → paste a public link → Analyze → Save. Downloads are unlimited; change the save folder in Settings anytime.
onboarding.clipboardBody: Optionally detect video page links you copy for a quick download. Off by default — turn on only if you want it. Change anytime in Settings.
onboarding.enginesBody: Missing tools: {{list}}. Open Settings → Core engines to fix, or reinstall the app.
onboarding.doneBody: Start with a single download — batch, enhance, subtitles, and mobile bridge are all included and free.
